text:
neha: Quick ask — need a small set of launch assets for the May demo: 1) compact decision-flow visual (for tweet + slide), 2) a carousel-ready social hero (1080x1080), 3) a printable one-pager PDF. Keep visuals simple, icon-driven.
ravi: Got it. Any mandatory copy or legal footers? File formats?

clare: Headline: "Serving smarter: cut cost, not quality". CTA for demo: "Register Demo — May 21". Use short bullets for one-pager. Add note that benchmarks are illustrative.

neha: Brand constraints: use sea-blue + charcoal, no illustrative photography, geometric icons only. Accessibility: alt text required and all text layers exported as separate strings for localization.

tom: Legal: add footer: "Synthetic examples only; not customer data. Results may vary." Avoid comparative claims without citation.

ravi: Export checklist I'll follow: social_1080x1080.png, decisionflow_800x1000.svg + png, onepager_A4_print.pdf. I'll add alt text into the file comments and create zh-CN/ja-JP text layers. ETA: 48 hours. publish-bot: Filed request in launch-board with priority high.

neha: Thanks — ping here when v1s are uploaded.
